name: GitHub Code Review Agent
description: Watch for a configurable label on GitHub pull requests, inspect full PR and repository context, and post an AI review comment once per label event.

github.message: Used to read pull requests and post review comments.

exampleImplementation:
Trigger: cron polling for open GitHub PRs with a configured label such as openhands-review
Required secret: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN, with permission to write pull request reviews

1. Read the repositories, trigger label, review tone, and polling schedule from setup.
2. Poll each repository independently, with its own state, so PR numbers never collide.
3. List open PRs and find the latest matching GitHub labeled issue event for each labeled PR.
4. Deduplicate on the label event ID so every label application queues exactly one review.
5. Extract the PR head commit into a directory of its own and start an OpenHands conversation with that directory as its workspace, so the agent reviews the exact commit without cloning anything.
6. Post an acknowledgement with the conversation link, then confirm on GitHub that the review was published for that head SHA, falling back to posting the agent's text as a comment.
7. Remove the checkout once the conversation has stopped, so nothing accumulates between runs.

schedule.label: Check frequency
schedule.help: How often to look for newly labelled pull requests.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.help: Timezone the schedule is interpreted in.

repositories.label: Repositories
repositories.help: The repositories whose pull requests will be reviewed. Each is polled independently and keeps its own state, so pull request numbers never collide between them.

triggerLabel.label: Trigger label
triggerLabel.help: Only pull requests carrying this label are reviewed.

reviewTone.label: Review tone
reviewTone.help: How detailed the review comments should be.

setup.message: This deployment cannot run the scheduled review automation directly. Set it up in this conversation instead: confirm the repository to review, the trigger label, the review tone, and the polling schedule, then create the automation.
